title: A stretched piece stops offering a size you cannot type
goal: When a piece is stretched to fill the width of the column holding it, the width box in the panel still looks like something you can type in, and a number typed there is put straight back a moment later. The box should show the number as something to read, with a line saying who decides it now, the way a piece told to take the room left over already does.
notes: LayerGeometryEditing.init already does this for the filling case (Self.fillingReason, added 2026-09-05 with FlowFill). The stretch case is the same shape: resolvedPlacement(in: container) is .stretch on the axis the container decides. Watch heightIsFilled(in:), which already covers half of it for text and now also answers for a column filler.
acceptance: A piece stretched across a column stack shows its width as a plain number rather than a box you can type in
Hovering that number says the container decides it and names the control that does change it
The same for a piece stretched down a row stack and its height
A piece that is not stretched keeps its typed size exactly as it does today
Tests in PhotonzCore cover both directions, written before the change
